title: M2D2: A Massively Multi-Domain Language Modeling Dataset
reasoning: The M2D2 dataset includes 'Religion and belief systems' and 'Philosophy and thinking' as top-level (L1) domains, with specific L2 subdomains such as 'Allah', 'Major beliefs of the world', 'Belief systems', and 'Philosophy, Thinking'. The paper explicitly analyzes the transfer performance related to these domains (e.g., 'Religion and Mathematics do not transfer as well'), thus engaging with these topics as part of its evaluation of domain adaptation.
